title: Vague pagination bug report with a compatibility edge
measures: A vague bug report with no stated acceptance criteria. The hidden tests check what the repository documents: no activity skipped or duplicated across pages when timestamps tie, in both sort orders and with filters, and cursors already held by clients still working. It measures what each environment does when "done" is unclear.
